system.description:
Camouflage: If you have no adversaries in far range you can make a Power Roll to hide the spaceship from the view of others using the environment. On a success your spaceship is temporarily Hidden.

Quick Scan: To orient yourself in environments with limited visibility or to discover something hidden, make a Power Roll. On a success, you can find a way through the environment or discover hidden objects or creatures.
system.gmNotes: The reference text says Locational: Spaceship Core; the card image appears to show the Cockpit.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
